title: CopilotKit/OpenDots
why_read: An AI-coworker product spanning text, voice calls, and Slack, interesting as a glimpse of agent integration patterns but light on technical depth from the description alone.
analysis: OpenDots appears to be a framework or product for deploying AI agents that persist across different communication channels like chat, voice calls, and Slack, acting as an 'always-on' team member. This is relevant to the growing space of agentic AI tooling and multi-channel integration, which is a real engineering challenge involving state management and channel-specific APIs. Without more detail on the underlying architecture, it's hard to assess novelty beyond the product pitch. It's worth a skim for people tracking the AI-agent tooling ecosystem rather than a deep technical resource.
